description: Defines the QhullFacetList class, a list container for QhullFacet objects, including methods for conversion, filtering, and printing, within the Qhull computational geometry library.

classes.name: QhullFacetList
classes.description: A list class managing QhullFacet objects, supporting filtering, conversion, and output formatting.

methods.name: toStdVector
methods.description: Converts the list of QhullFacet objects to a std::vector.

methods.name: vertices_toStdVector
methods.description: Converts the list of vertices associated with facets to a std::vector.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Returns a PrintFacetList object for formatted output with a message.

methods.name: printFacets
methods.description: Returns a PrintFacets object for formatted output of facets.

methods.name: printVertices
methods.description: Returns a PrintVertices object for formatted output of vertices.
